newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC in jv with Kanowna.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC in jv with Kanowna.

text.p: Minerals explorer Kanowna Consolidated Gold Mines NL said on Thursday it had agreed terms with WMC Ltd for WMC to earn a 70 percent stake in the St Alvano nickel and gold joint venture in Western Australia.
Kanowna said WMC would have to spend A$7.5 million over a seven year period to earn the 70 percent interest.

The St Alvano project is 827 sq km in area and includes all tenements held by or for Kanowna in the Mt Monger and Parker Hill areas, Kanowna said. St Alvano is 50 km east of WMC's Kambalda nickel operations and St Ives gold treatment plants.

Kanowna said the terms of the joint venture are for WMC to spend A$1.2 million over a 24 month period before the right to withdraw, followed by A$2.4 million over a 30 month period to earn a 51 percent equity and A$3.9 million over a further 30 month period to increase equity to 70 percent.
The joint venture is subject to a formal legal agreement being entered into, Kanowna said.
At 10.35 a.m. (2335 GMT), WMC shares were one cent lower at A$7.61. Kanowna shares have not traded since Wednesday when they fell 10 cents to A$2.40.
